definitions.explanation: Any payment transaction conducted electronically without physical cash, including credit cards, debit cards, mobile payments, QR code payments, and online transfers.

examples.japanese: {電子決済|でんしけっさい}で{支払|しはら}う。
この{店|みせ}は{電子決済|でんしけっさい}に{対応|たいおう}している。
{電子決済|でんしけっさい}の{普及|ふきゅう}で{現金|げんきん}{使用|しよう}が{減|へ}った。
examples.english: The spread of electronic payment has reduced cash usage.

examples.japanese: {電子決済|でんしけっさい}サービスを{導入|どうにゅう}する。
examples.english: To introduce an electronic payment service.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {電子|でんし} (electronic) + {決済|けっさい} (settlement/payment).

TYPES OF {電子決済|でんしけっさい}:
・クレジットカード (credit card)
・デビットカード (debit card)
・QRコード{決済|けっさい} (QR code payment: PayPay, LINE Pay, etc.)
・{交通|こうつう}ICカード (transit IC cards: Suica, PASMO, etc.)
・{電子|でんし}マネー (e-money: iD, QUICPay, etc.)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{電子決済|でんしけっさい}を{利用|りよう}する (to use electronic payment)
・{電子決済|でんしけっさい}に{対応|たいおう}する (to accept electronic payment)
・{電子決済|でんしけっさい}サービス (electronic payment service)
・キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい} (cashless payment - synonym)

CONTEXT: Japan has seen rapid growth in electronic payment adoption, especially since the COVID-19 pandemic and government cashless promotion campaigns. Major services include PayPay, LINE Pay, d{払|ばら}い, and {楽天|らくてん}ペイ.
